blocks.text:
After breakfast, depart for Puno by tourist bus.

Several stops are planned along the way. The first is the town of Andahuaylillas and its chapel, followed by Raqchi and the Temple of the god Wiracocha.

The route includes lunch and a stop near La Raya, the natural border between the Cusco and Puno regions.

Before arriving in Puno, visit the Pucará Museum, where you can also buy a traditional bull-shaped ceramic figurine.

Arrive in Puno in the evening and check in at your hotel.
